title: OpenGL-Dream-Village: deterministic immediate-mode OpenGL animation with a pixel-exact software-rasteriser test harness
description: Animated 2D village scene in immediate-mode OpenGL (C++17, FreeGLUT) restructured into an explicit AnimationState and a pure render function; a purpose-written software rasteriser (49 GL/GLUT entry points, top-left fill rule, double-precision edge functions) enables pixel-exact regression tests on CI (0 pixel differences on 4 scenes, 0 GL errors) across Linux, macOS and Windows/VS2022. Scene geometry by krishnodey/Dream-Village (attributed).
